records.purpose_and_behavior_taken: Independently authored Swift implements a typed one-shot state machine from owner-observed interoperability facts: subscribe to FF31, send one 38-byte 0xE2 authentication to FF32, require the exact five-byte decrypted 0xE2 acceptance with code 0x01 and detail 0x00, send one seven-byte 0x39 effective-data request, validate 0x39 and 0x32 data, then disconnect after five unique live indexes. Private cryptographic and owner material enter only through a post-install file import into a device-only Keychain item. No activation, binding, reset, retry, reconnect, arbitrary write, background mode, vendor binary, or vendor source is included.
